units.source_text: [\[23\]](#part1336.html#w23) 催马乐《石川》云：“石川高丽人，取了我的带。

en.t: The saibara song Ishikawa says, "The Koryo man of Ishikawa took my sash.

units.source_text: 我心甚后悔，可恨又可叹。

en.t: My heart is full of regret; it is hateful and sorrowful.
What kind of sash did he take?
He took the pale blue sash.

units.source_text: 深恐失此带，恩情中途断。”

en.t: I deeply fear that if I lose this sash, our love will be cut off halfway."

units.source_text: 时人信为男女幽会时倘带被人取去，则恩情中绝。

en.t: People of the time believed that when a man and woman met in secret, if someone took away the sash, their bond of love would be broken midway.
